turns.q: How do I use it properly the very first time?
turns.replyTail:
the recommended steps are:



Check the parts in your divider set.


Plan your layout around your gear first.


Install the longest dividers first.


Add the smaller dividers after.


If needed, use a sheet of paper to help position dividers, then remove it so the hook-and-loop fastens.
